limitations: This is a candidate ledger revision, not a measured platform release.
Seventeen newly declared behaviours have planned bindings and remain UNVERIFIED.
The matrix comparator has synthetic red controls; target flag-on and altered-cell proof belong to the demo build session.
Revision 3 inventory corrections are candidates: implemented SQL reads have fixture red controls only, and every new behavioural binding is planned.

Revision 6 edit-layout and field-placement checks have pure-rule red controls and SQL bindings only; Admin API and MCP bindings are planned. A legitimate 0 in a number field reads as no value in global-fields-filled, a tab named exactly like a category id is an offender, and a shared-category tab counts for every family in tabs-per-product.

mapped.reason: Already admitted in revision 2 from the release scan; absent from 10.28.15 (admission exclusion).

No separate platform carrier. Box contents that are products are one more relation group kind (pim.product-relations, one group per kind); contents that are not products are a declared list or long-text attribute (pim.field-types, pim.list-fields).
The carrier is the Product Catalog app's Compare template (platform), not Swift; Swift 2 ships no compare template.

checkCorrections.note: Counted every DetailType 0 row as an image, so a product with only a PDF document was an offender. Both EXISTS clauses now require an image file extension.
Same defect as images-without-default: a document counted as an image. Restricted to image file extensions.

Counted category fields only; a model that puts shared typed attributes on global fields failed. Global custom fields (ProductFieldIsStandard = 0) are now counted with category fields; the profile threshold is unchanged.
Read only the product stock figure; stock kept per location does not roll up into it. A stock unit of the same product and variant above zero now counts.

Counted every returned row; the 0.6.x add-in returns all item types, healthy ones included, so a healthy host failed eq 0. Split in two filtered counts: existsInSchema false here, existsInMeta false in table-health-metadata.
Stated as configured: a stored rule did not change the unit a feed printed in the ruled language. The behaviour is the new rendered check.
Binding stays planned; the reason now records the measured read and the handler it needs.
Planned binding moved to the status tool; the log tool misses completed runs.
Planned binding moved to the status tool; the log tool misses completed runs.

Passed any active layout that had a tab: it read no screen type, did not check that editors resolve and said nothing about which tab a family's fields sit on. Replaced by nine edit-layout checks (handler pim-edit-layout) with their limits as binding arguments: one active layout for the full ProductEditScreen type, resolving editors, a pure tab per family, at most 5 tabs per product, 12 editors per group and 30 per tab, no mechanism names, one catch-all group, unique group names and a stated division.

Ground under-25-fields-per-family is replaced by one-attribute-family: a catalogue with two or more families that carry fields can no longer rule the layout out because each family is small. A ruling on the old ground is an invalid ruling.
